_doc: Staging bank for VerifySegment ('Segmentation striptease', brainstorm #7). Wave-merge agent splices sharedPrompts[] into each of banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json prompts[] (shr_ ids identical across all four). Grading is BINARY via `answer` (the compliant bucket index); segment.js owns the reveal-ledger -> option-index mapping and never displays these labels as buttons. See notes.

sfxWanted.desc: the Climax flood-clear reward: a soft, rising wash/whoosh (~0.7s) as all 16 blurred squares resolve to the full image at once. Fires ALONGSIDE the registered 'captcha-verify-ok' so the payoff is audible even before this asset is authored (missing manifest entry = silent, never an error). Add to SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK in render/audio.js on authoring.

voExtra.desc: OPTIONAL, currently unwired. Deadpan stinger for the Establishing 40% denial-of-completion stamp ('interval elapsed. remainder withheld.'). segment.js uses chrome.stamp (text-only) today; wiring needs an audio.voice() call site in segment.js plus a manifest entry. Ships silent-safe if omitted.

notes: MERGE: append the 5 sharedPrompts into every banks/<niche>.json prompts[]; ids are identical across all four (shr_ shared-baseline block, like shr_h0_* / shr_cap_grid_*). weight 2.5 across the ladder. DO NOT reorder options: segment.js maps its reveal ledger to a fixed option index — 0 refusal / 1 partial / 2 substantial-or-interval / 3 full-reveal — and the per-band `answer` names which bucket reads as compliant (cal=3 straight full completion, est=2 the ~40% interval the SYSTEM cuts at, deep=3 near-full after the saved squares resume, climax=3 select-all, recovery=2 marked-complete). The reveal BITMASK and reveal ORDER (face/body/spiral-first) have NO AnswerEvent channel (makeAnswerEvent exposes only chosenIndex/value/pickHeat), so those telemetry dimensions are folded into the option index alone — do NOT extend contracts.js to carry them. CROSS-BEAT SAVED STATE: Deepening resumes Establishing's cleared squares from a module-level ledger in segment.js (per page load, reset defensively when a fresh Calibration/Establishing beat opens or qIndex regresses) — no bank/host plumbing needed. Recovery entry (shr_cap_segment_rec) is FORWARD-LOOKING: the engine currently hardcodes Recovery lines and does not read the bank in Recovery (primer §5); ship it dormant — segment.js already handles band==='recovery' (clear image + a 'segmentation complete' checkbox that re-blurs on check) if the wiring later invokes it. _rec is heat 0 and carries mechanicHints:['verifysegment'] per the recovery-must-be-verify* rule. VO rides q_<id> automatically (text = spoken line verbatim) — run build_intake_manifest.py after merge; cal/est share the printed card instruction but have distinct ids so they get distinct heat-directed clips. BASE IMAGE: Calibration uses a generated mundane authored colour-field (straight, light 6px blur, fully completable); Establishing/Deepening/Climax use ONE static user image at 40px blur (preferred from ctx.media.images so nothing animates; a gif is one distinct animation if that is all that is present); empty ctx.media falls back to an authored colour field, still playable. No host media bump needed (one image per beat). All niche-flavoured verdict/UI strings (refusal label, denial/deep/climax/recovery verdicts, resume note, recovery checkbox caption) live in segment.js STRINGS keyed by niche (bambi/drone/sissy/circe), circe register respected (no exclamations/diminutives/em-dashes).
